The person who does the work

Dr David Burnell

Burnell Consultancy Ltd is a UK platform security engineering consultancy founded by Dr David Burnell. It takes credentials out of code, makes machine images compliant by default, and turns scanner noise into a prioritised roadmap. The founder architected secrets management at more than 1,000 Vault namespaces and moved CIS Level 1 compliance from 25% to over 95% in a single programme.

Career: IBM Security to G-Research

Dave has spent his career at the platform-security end of engineering. He began at IBM Security, moved through HP, then built and scaled secrets and identity platforms at G-Research, one of Europe's leading quantitative-finance firms, and at Aristocrat in regulated gaming. The common thread is making security work at scale inside fast-moving engineering organisations: Vault at 1,000-plus namespaces, golden-image factories, PKI and non-human identity.

Doctorate and publications

Dave holds a PhD in Biological Chemistry from Durham University. His doctoral thesis is publicly available in the Durham e-Theses archive. His research was published in two peer-reviewed journals: PLOS Biology (2013) and BMC Bioinformatics (2013). The research grounding matters here: platform security is an evidence discipline, and the habit of measuring before asserting carries directly into the work.

Open source

Dave's open-source history includes the ΔΔPT toolbox, built during his research years. The same instinct, publishing methods so others can check and reuse them, is why every engagement leaves you owning the code and the runbooks rather than renting them.

The company

Burnell Consultancy Ltd is registered in England and Wales, company number [placeholder], based in Godalming, Surrey. It is deliberately a boutique: the person you meet on the assessment call is the person who reads your pipelines and writes your remediation plan. There is no bench of juniors and no reseller margin. We are vendor-neutral across HashiCorp Vault, OpenBao, cloud KMS and CyberArk.
